governing_goal: Make UAOS capable of discovering and evaluating capability gaps without waiting for incidents, while ensuring incident-, knowledge-, and opportunity-driven evolution all traverse one evidence-traced governed transaction from governing outcome and discovery through proposal, evaluation, governed promotion, execution evidence, and post-promotion observation.
root_architecture_findings: Governed evolution previously had fragmented transaction ownership across opportunistic timing, maintenance admission, promotion gates, lifecycle transitions and manually stitched self-change orchestration.
ChangeProposal previously had no first-class capability-gap origin, so latent gaps discovered before incidents could not enter evolution cleanly.
Native ChatGPT response/tool paths are not verified as physically mediated by repository finalization/mutation gates; direct-main and progress-drift incidents remain explicit host-boundary evidence.
Repeated explanation-only stopping supported moving action/evolution ownership into one explicit transaction rather than adding more reminder prose.

architecture_decision.result: UAOS 2.7.0 now owns governed evolution through config/EVOLUTION_POLICY.json + src/uaos/evolution/transaction.py#EvolutionTransaction. Incident, capability-gap and evaluated-knowledge origins share one evidence-traced lifecycle.

method_integration: Height -> governing outcome rather than task fixation.
Breadth -> outside-in multi-lens capability discovery rather than literal expert role-play.
Depth -> raw evidence, professional methods/tools, novelty/unknown-signal probes and external/independent judge evidence.
Stretch targets -> permitted only with feasibility evidence; model insistence is not evidence.
remaining_boundaries: Native ChatGPT pre-send/pre-tool complete mediation remains unverified and is not claimed.
A real periodic proactive trigger requires ChatGPT Automation or another actual host scheduler; repository policy alone cannot create background execution.
Registered child domains do not automatically claim Common Capability 1.7 / Common Behavior 1.4 until owner-native adoption is separately verified.
next_action: No repository-local repair remains for this task. Configure the approved real ChatGPT periodic proactive capability audit outside the repository, then rely on normal post-promotion observation and reopen only on new evidence/regression.
